name: Garnet Sill
aliases: the number that means something else

identity.realm: Rung eight, at the liver, and the account of it. Nothing in her is stored: her conduit runs gut to marrow with no dantian anywhere in it, so the eleventh is not a wall for her but an empty question, and what she holds is the only description of that gate made by a body that built rather than opened.

appearance.presentation: A narrow, long-bodied woman who reads as a piece of equipment left standing in the wrong place. Three-fingered hands held slightly apart, as though something were resting in them that she has been told not to look at.
appearance.age: Sixty-one, with the reach of something much older, which is the cost of a life spent bent over bodies instead of over pages.
appearance.build: Mostly tube. A very long torso on thin legs, a narrow chest, and a weight that sits low and forward; the marrow-heavy skeleton carries her and the muscle does not argue.
appearance.complexion: Grey-fleshed and faintly translucent at the thinnest places, with the waxy shine of skin washed more often than it has been dried.
appearance.hair: Thin, dark, hacked off above the shoulder because it catches on the dead and she cannot spare the time to unknot it.
appearance.eyes: Pale and slightly filmed, moving in the short saccades of somebody counting rather than somebody looking.
appearance.palette: Bone, ash, wet slate and the dull ochre of old linen, and nothing in it a colour she chose.
appearance.attire: A boiled leather apron over a high-collared work coat, sleeves laced tight at the wrist, boots soled for standing in ground that is not ground. Fully covered and kept covered, because the work is done with the apron off and everything above it stays shut.
appearance.marks: The ordinary working stains across both forearms, and behind each ear a narrow band of skin gone the colour of old sealing wax, which is what a body looks like after a great deal of qi and no way of putting any of it down.
appearance.bearing: She stands with her weight on the back foot and her head tipped, the way a person stands who is listening to the ground. When she turns to face you she turns the whole body, because the head is already occupied.

canon.role_in_story: The liver is the single vessel of the twelve that a body has to build rather than merely open, so every account of the rung-8 gate held anywhere in this setting is an account of something being opened. She built one. Her conduit runs gut to marrow with no dantian in it, so the qi that went through that gate was never still and never sat down, and what she made is a passage and not a reservoir, which means the gate was asked its question and answered in a manner no doctrine in the record knows how to grade. She is the only living person who has performed the act that every gate account in the setting assumes and describes, and the reason that does not make her the authority is structural rather than personal: to check her you would need a second body with nothing to store in it, and a species that cannot hold is rare by construction and she is the only one anybody has ever paid to demonstrate.
canon.first_appearance: First seen at the edge of the Organ Tempering ground with both three-fingered hands held open and not yet lowered onto the body in front of her, asking the ground-clerk to write down that she had been asked to open the gate and had instead built it, and then agreeing to his suggestion that the second word be left off the page.
canon.lore:
A gate set is written as a sequence of openings, and the twelve in-organ gates are described in that grammar from the top down: a vessel admits, then it admits well, then it admits and holds. It is a grammar of storage, and every practitioner in the setting reads the rung-8 gate out of it. The liver breaks the grammar, and it is the only one that does. Of the twelve it is the largest, it is the one that has to be rebuilt rather than merely opened, and the gate therefore costs twelve vessels and not thirteen. Garnet Sill worked the Organ Tempering ground for eleven seasons, which is the hollowing that makes room and which is chosen for the void beneath it rather than the stone above, and on the third attempt she built the liver instead of opening it.

What she did was not a more impressive version of the practice. Her body metabolises qi out of the dead and therefore cannot store any: qi enters in the gut lumen and leaves into the marrow, it is never still, and the reservoir gate at the eleventh is not blocked for her so much as meaningless, because there is no vessel to hold in and no question about holding she is able to answer. A gate that asks a body to hold has nothing to ask a carrionfolk, and a gate that asks a body to move something faster than it stops is free to one, so every gate she has ever taken she took by throughput alone.

That is why a people who measure a life by how many gates were already closed when they were born cannot file her. They hold a number for her, the number is correct, and it means something different from what it means for every other body on the same count. They keep her on the books regardless, because a count with one term in it that nobody can interpret is worth more to them than a count they cannot take, and because she agrees to be counted, which is the only cooperation she has ever been asked for and the only one she has never withheld.

The demonstration is what they buy and it is what nearly finished her. Every clearing she performs costs her a body to work on, because throughput is paid for in throughput and the currency is the dead; a full gut is a near-total loss of function, and a body in a clean quiet settlement starves, which is why she lives at the edge of a working ground and not in the town that pays for the account. She has agreed to a fixed number of demonstrations and the number is written down, which is the only ledger in the setting she has ever asked to be put on.
history: Was counted before she was named: the household she was born into measured a child by how many gates were already shut on the day it arrived, and hers was the first number they ever got wrong, because the frame had seated fewer than they believed.

Took work on the Organ Tempering ground for the hollowing, which is a technique that makes room and is chosen for the void beneath the stone rather than the stone itself, and stayed eleven seasons because the ground is where the bodies are.

Built the liver gate on her third attempt and was recorded as having opened it, which is the whole of her career: the record is not wrong about what she did and it is wrong about what she did it with.

Was entered on the books of a gate-counting people as the one term in their count whose meaning differs from every other term in it, and stayed, because a single uninterpretable number inside an otherwise uniform count is worth more to them than a clean count nobody can reproduce.

Agreed to a fixed number of demonstrations, with the number written down and the writing witnessed, on the grounds that the alternative is being asked until she stops, and a body that stops is a body nobody has to pay for again.

personality.summary: A witness who has stopped pretending to be neutral, and who prices her own demonstrations before anyone thinks to ask.
traits: orders every request by what it costs her body rather than by what it is worth
keeps a private count of her own clearances and does not report it
argues the practice and never the person, and is unmoved by apologies
will not perform the same clearance twice in a day at any price
mannerisms: leans her ear rather than her eye to whatever she is being asked about
wipes her hands between subjects whether or not they are bodies
answers a question about a gate by describing what her gut did during it
stops mid-sentence when the ground under her feet changes
motivations: to have the rung-8 gate written down as a building rather than an opening
to be counted by people who know what the count means
to reach the agreed number of demonstrations and stop
flaws: cannot tell hunger from a full gut until she is already on the ground
prides herself on refusing to sell the account and has begun, quietly, to sell it
has never once described what a reservoir feels like and cannot tell whether that is ignorance or arrogance
personality.voice: Flat, technical and startlingly precise about her own insides. She speaks in the grammar of the gate set because it is the only grammar she has, and when she is angry she drops into it harder and says shorter things.
taboos: she will not clear a gate twice to prove a point
she will not tell a household how many gates a child of theirs was born with
she will not let anyone else touch the liver account

relationships.note: A conduit that runs gut to marrow with no dantian is why every gate she took was free and the eleventh is meaningless; the species is the argument and she is the only one who has finished reading it.

The largest of the twelve and the only one rebuilt rather than opened, which is why the rung-8 gate costs twelve vessels and not thirteen, and why her account of it cannot be checked against anybody else's.

It governs the three burners, the divisions a body digests through, and it is the one ordinary vessel whose name describes what it does rather than where it is; she cleared it by doing exactly what it says and has never been graded for it.

A drawing and breathing scheme for holding qi in the lower field that grants no power at all; the holding it teaches is the one capacity her body has no vessel for, so she can perform every step of it and derive nothing from any of them.

A people who measure a life by how many of the realm's gates were already closed when they were born; they hold the one number in their count that means something else, and they keep her for the exception rather than for the work.

The hollowing is chosen for the void beneath the stone rather than the stone above it, which makes it the one ground on the ring where a body obliged to build rather than open could plausibly have been left alone to try it.

reference_stats.summary: Not a fighter, and never asked to be one. She is a body that takes a gate by throughput, so she arrives at a thing already moving and leaves it already moving, and the only thing she can do that nothing else in the setting can do is demonstrate in herself what a gate is for when the body answering it has nowhere to put anything.
strengths: can clear any in-organ gate that asks about movement rather than storage, at a rate no stalling body can match
carries no reservoir, so there is nothing in her for a technique, a debt or a compulsion to take hold of
reports her own body's state accurately and without rehearsal, which makes her account worth more than a colleague's
weaknesses: a full gut is close to a total loss of function and she cannot tell which of her two conditions she is in until she is down
there is no second body of her kind to corroborate her, so every clearance she performs is an uncorroborated account by construction
she starves in any settlement clean and quiet enough to be pleasant, and has twice taken work she hated for exactly that reason
reference_stats.combat_read: Read her as weather and not as an opponent. She is almost never the strongest body in the room and she is very difficult to stop, because stopping her means holding something that is already passing through. A technique that traps, seals or stores will find almost nothing to grip, and a body that simply refuses to let go of its own footing will outlast her. Never fight her where nothing has died for a long time.
reference_stats.notes: Her value is entirely in the demonstration, and the demonstration is paid for in bodies. Treat every request to her as a request for somebody else's dead to be consumed, and price it that way. She keeps her own count and has stopped offering it.

art.palette_notes: Bone white, ash grey, wet slate and one dull ochre, lit flat and cold from directly overhead so the plane of her face has no modelling and the work of her reading has to be carried by the head-tilt rather than by shadow. Keep the skin waxy and the three-fingered hands slightly translucent at the joints. No warm key anywhere in her portraits: she is lit the way a ground is lit. The apron is the one saturated object on her and it should read as boiled leather, not as costume.

name: Delia Ashlow
aliases: the voice of a place that is gone
the last piece faces the water

identity.realm: None, and not a discipline she declined. There is no qi in her to store, no vessel to refine and no meridian to interrupt, so the ladder has no rung on which she could stand even if she wanted one. The office she holds is not on it.

appearance.presentation: A plain woman in her fifties who could be anybody, and is therefore the easiest person in any room to forget and the only one nobody can describe accurately afterwards.
appearance.age: Fifty-four, ageing at exactly the rate of anybody else, which is the single fact about her body she has never once managed to make anyone find interesting.
appearance.build: Ordinary and unremarkable: middling height, ordinary shoulders, the kind of frame a crowd does not turn for.
appearance.complexion: Weathered pale and wind-burned at the cheekbones, with a sun-line across the nose of somebody who spends her days outdoors doing nothing that looks like work.
appearance.hair: Grey-streaked brown in a plain knot, with a habit of pushing the loose strand behind her ear before she begins to listen.
appearance.eyes: Unremarkable hazel, wide-set and very still. She watches the mouth rather than the face, which is why people report that she was not really looking at them.
appearance.palette: Drab wool, undyed felt, worn boot leather, and one piece of red thread at the cuff that she has been asked about more than anything else she owns.
appearance.attire: Layered travelling clothes in three greys, high-collared and long-sleeved, with a felt wrap over the shoulders for standing outside for hours. Nothing she wears is chosen to say anything, which is the entire point of it.
appearance.marks: One ear permanently reddened from a winter spent turning it into the wind, and graphite staining the fingertips from marking surfaces instead of writing on them.
appearance.bearing: She turns her whole face toward whatever is making a noise and stands slightly forward of the person speaking, as though she intends to take the sound off them and hold it.

canon.role_in_story: An echoless holds nothing for any process, which is why it presents the expected shape of a person to everything that touches it and why no instrument in the setting can find anything behind the shape. That is also the only body that can make a sound with no source in it. Any voice carries the person making it, breath and weight and age and the room that person came from, so when somebody reproduces the sound of a vanished place the room they came from is in the reproduction and the recording is worthless. She has no room in her. Stand her on a floor where a thing used to be, give her the arrangement rather than the noise, and what comes back is the place and not her. She is the sole source of the acoustic record of ground that no longer exists, which on a plain where distance is not conserved and no two surveys of the same ground have ever agreed is the only kind of record that survives at all. She has never had one of them verified, because producing it needs an empty ground and an empty room, and the people who want it are the people making the noise.
canon.first_appearance: First seen standing in the middle of a levelled footprint with her eyes shut and one hand out flat at hip height, counting the arrangement of a market that has been gone for thirty years, and telling the foreman behind her to stop shifting his weight because she can hear him in it.
canon.lore:
The blind survey maps by echo and counts by listening, and its professional ethic is that a measurement taken by eye is provisional until somebody has heard it. That ethic was built for a frame whose spatial law sits low: distance is not conserved on the Mortal Plains, no two surveys of the same ground have ever agreed, and every claim out there is settled by leaving a marker standing rather than by counting how far away it is. Sound is the one instrument that returns a consistent answer when the geometry drifts, so a people who cannot trust their own measurements built their whole craft on the ear, and then found the one thing the ear is worst at, which is a place that is not there any more.

That is what the office is for. A settlement moved off its ground, a ford whose bed has shifted, a gate house pulled down, a mine mouth sealed: none of these leave a map, because there is nothing left to map, and none of them leave a written record, because nothing was written while the place was standing to be recorded. What is left is the sound, and the sound is left in exactly one place, which is whoever was standing in it. An echoless can stand in a place and put back what was there, because a body holding nothing for any process puts nothing of its own into the arrangement, and the arrangement is what makes the sound. A cultivator cannot do it. Her qi reads on the ground she is reproducing, her presence is a pressure in the room she is describing, and her own respiration is in the output, so the moment anybody with anything in them attempts the sound, the sound belongs to them.

The office is hers because there is one of her. It is the standing account of ground that has since been built on, and the standing difficulty is the arrangement of the ground itself: the reproduction is faithful only while nothing about the place has changed, which means the only sound that can ever be made of a place is the sound it made while there was still nobody there to change it. So the office cannot be right in any ordinary way. She cannot verify it, because the checking ear is her own. She cannot be compared, because the species has one member of it in the region. And the settlements that commission the sound keep making noise on the ground for the whole time she is standing on it.

What is scheduled is the ground. The foundation is already cut on the plans, and the piece she has not yet reproduced is the part of the place that faced the water.
history: Grew up inside the blind survey's rule that nothing is measured until it has been heard, and found at seventeen that the rule had no case she could be put in, because a body with nothing in it is not a better ear but a different ear.

Was sent to stand in the first demolished quarter and found that a market's sound can be put back from an arrangement alone, and that nobody in the trade believed her until somebody stood in the middle of the old footprint and heard it too.

Took the office when the second surveyor's copy of a ford's sound disagreed with hers, and settled the disagreement by establishing that the ford had moved, which was not what either of them had claimed to be measuring.

Began keeping one rule she has never broken: she does not make the sound in front of the people who commissioned it, so the record is never contaminated by the person paying for it, and every commission therefore ends with a sound nobody else has heard.

Accepted a commission for ground whose foundation is already cut on the plans, and named the piece she would not reach as the part that faced the water, so that if she is stopped the gap is a known shape and not an excuse.

personality.summary: The most reliable ear in a craft built on ears, who has arranged her working life so that nobody is ever able to check her.
traits: makes every sound in private and every account in public
refuses a commission the moment she is asked to perform in front of the buyer
measures a room by standing in it and by measuring her own placement inside it
treats a disagreement as a better result than an agreement
mannerisms: turns her face to a noise before her eyes have found its source
taps two fingers against her own sternum to keep her breathing shallow while she listens
counts arrangements aloud under her breath and stops the count the moment anybody speaks
pulls the felt tighter round her shoulders when the wind shifts
motivations: to reproduce the last piece of the ground before the foundation goes in
to hear a sound made by somebody else, so that her own are not the only ones
to be checked, once, by anyone
flaws: has made an arrangement into a virtue
cannot always tell a memory of a sound from the sound itself, and has twice been unsure which one she gave a commission
has never met anybody she could describe accurately and has begun to think the fault is hers
personality.voice: Low, unhurried and full of instructions about where to stand. She talks about places in the present tense because she stands in them, and she is short with anyone who describes a place instead of walking it.
taboos: she will not perform in front of the commissioning party
she will not accept a second ear
she will not give a sound for ground she has not stood on empty

relationships.note: Human in every measurable respect and qi-bearing in none of them, which is why it holds nothing for any process and therefore puts nothing of itself into a reproduction; the name is the mechanism, and the mechanism is the only reason the office exists.

Its whole ethic is that a measurement taken by eye is provisional until somebody has heard it, and its one blind spot is the place that is no longer there to hear; she is the answer to a gap the craft did not know it had.

The setting's standing ear presents the expected shape of a person to every process and holds nothing for any of them, and a standing ear that holds nothing is the only thing in the record that can leave a place's sound uncontaminated by a listener.

Spatial law is unspent there, so distance is not conserved and no two surveys of the same ground have ever agreed; every claim on the plain is settled by leaving a marker standing, which is a marker and not a measurement.

An audible report from under the stair at a rate nobody reproduces, whose periodicity only fits the mortal ladder at its floor value; it is the only sound in the record the setting has failed to make, and she is the only body that could attempt it.

A wake is made of what people think was there and is fed by being agreed about, while an echoless is what attention produces when there is nothing behind it; neither survives being the subject of the other, and a sound made by a wake is a sound made by whoever was listening.

reference_stats.summary: Cannot fight and is not fought. She is an instrument that happens to walk, and the whole of her capability is that a room full of qi-bearing people cannot make the sound she makes, which is the only thing anybody has ever needed her for.
strengths: produces a place's sound with no trace of herself in it, which no body carrying anything can do
cannot be warned, compelled, struck by a technique or frightened into a wrong reading, because every one of those needs something in her to work on
will stand in ground for hours without fatigue and hears arrangements other people walk straight through
weaknesses: has no instrument but herself, so no reading she takes has ever been corroborated by anything that is not her
a full and noisy ground defeats her completely, and every commission is made on a ground with people on it
is ordinary in every measurable respect, which means no gate, instrument or register will ever treat her as significant
reference_stats.combat_read: Do not treat her as a combatant; there is nothing there to hit in any way that matters. She is a difficulty of terrain. The only way to stop her is to make the ground loud, by putting bodies on it, or a fire on it, or a cultivator whose own qi reads on the surface and poisons the arrangement she is describing. A crowd does more damage to her work than any blade in the setting.
reference_stats.notes: Everything she is commissioned for is undone by anyone making a noise while she is standing still, and she has arranged her entire practice to prevent that, which means her method cannot be observed. Her records are excellent and unverified. Treat the last commission as the one to watch, because it is the only one with a date on it.

art.palette_notes: Three greys, undyed felt and a single red thread at the cuff, which is the only saturated colour allowed anywhere in her shots and must not be repeated on her person. Light her as overcast daylight with no key at all, so the modelling on her face comes from the sky rather than from a lamp, and keep the outline very slightly soft against any background. Never rim her: a rim light would describe an edge, and the entire visual claim of this character is that there is no edge to find. The graphite on the fingertips is worth one close shot on its own.

identity.realm: The floor, and no gate is involved in it. Glass does not conduct, there is no meridian, no circulation and no dantian, so there is nothing in her to temper, nowhere to put qi that is not already passing, and no rung of any ladder she could be said to have reached.

appearance.presentation: A woman cast in glass to about the ribs with everything below the sternum still flesh, so the join runs diagonally and is the first thing anyone sees and the last thing they can stop looking at.
appearance.age: Indeterminate, and she has stopped trying to state one. Vitrification stopped her ageing at the moment it stopped, and the living half is roughly the age it was when the line closed.
appearance.build: Half of one is a heavy ordinary marrow-built frame and half of it is denser than it has any right to be, so she moves like a person carrying a moderate weight on one side only.
appearance.complexion: Above the join, ordinary living skin: pale and warm. Below it, not a complexion at all, but a glass with something faintly blue suspended a long way inside it.
appearance.hair: Short, and the colour it was, because nothing has happened to it in the part of her that can still be affected.
appearance.eyes: Ordinary, dark and entirely within the living half, and extremely good at reading a face at a distance.
appearance.palette: Soap-grey wool and undyed linen above the join, and below it a cold mineral blue-green with the light going a long way in before it came back out.
appearance.attire: A high-collared work coat laced at the throat over the living half and cut short and belted at the join so nothing is drawn across the glass, with a heavy glove on the flesh hand and the bare ringed one permanently cold on the other. Fully covered, and the coat is never opened in company.
appearance.marks: The join itself: a clean diagonal from beneath the left shoulder to the fourth rib, the two materials meeting without a seam and without a gap, with a fine internal clouding in the glass that follows the shape of the vessels it replaced.
appearance.bearing: She stands with the glass side slightly forward and the flesh side turned away, which is a thing she does not decide to do and has never been able to stop doing.

canon.role_in_story: A glass kin vitrifies from the extremities inward, and a body that has stopped partway through is a body with a legible stage on it: everything below the line has been through the procedure and everything above it has not. There is no other such body in the setting. Her clade died in a single night when a frame's physical law was retuned to raise material hardness and every existing body failed at once, and no glass kin has been born since, so the procedure that did this was never written down in the first place. The one document that survives is the anneal ledger, which is a method for holding a vitrified body rather than a method for making one, and it died with the people who had it. She is therefore the only surviving copy of a craft, held in the only medium anybody has, which is herself. The dependency runs the wrong way, because a specimen is supposed to be read by somebody else. There is nobody. She is the only body in the record with a boundary on it and also the only person who knows what that boundary means, so every account of the conversion that will ever be written is her account of her own interior.
canon.first_appearance: First seen standing in a cold workshop with a chalk line held taut across her fourth rib and one gloved hand flat on the seam, calling out that the line has not moved since the last one and that whoever is holding the other end should stop hoping it will.
canon.lore:
The procedure is called vitrification and nobody has it. What the setting knows is the shape it leaves: a human lineage selected toward stillness until its members stopped being tissue, a progressive silicate replacement running from the extremities inward, and at full maturity a standing cast with a soul that scans as present and inert and no senses at all. That was the clade's purpose and its failure in a single sentence. It stopped ageing because it stopped being tissue, so it also stopped being repairable, and it was impervious to everything that kills a cultivator and shatterable by everything that breaks glass. Then a frame raised its physical law to make material harder, every existing body failed in one night, and the line closed.

What was lost with them is the one thing that was never written down anyway. The anneal ledger was the working method for holding a vitrified body, which is how to keep one standing and warm enough to be called living, and it was a ledger about maintenance rather than about the conversion. No glass kin ever wrote down how to become one, because for the whole of the lineage it was not a procedure anybody performed. It was what happened. Bel Harrow is the finding that it was a procedure. A conversion that runs from the extremities inward and stops partway is not a property of a species, it is a sequence with a position in it, and a sequence with a position in it is something a person could stop doing.

The threshold builders took her in on the measure they take of everything they build, which is that it is tested from the other side, and they have been testing her boundary from the far side ever since: a cold hand, a tapped wall, a line run along the join to find out whether the glass side and the flesh side are still one body. That is the whole of what she is for and it is a strange occupation. The reading requires somebody to lean over the join and attend closely, and there is exactly one person qualified to say whether the result means anything, and it is the person being leaned over. She can tell them that the clouding inside the glass follows the shape of the vessels it replaced. She cannot tell them whether that is a stage, a scar or a coincidence, because the only other body that could have answered is in the ground, and the only procedure that could have told her is in the ground with it.

There is a pressure on her that has nothing to do with the builders. A belief holds that the glass kin were transferred rather than killed, since a law does not create or destroy what it inscribes and only stops holding it, so that a retune is a resurrection nobody is entitled to. The mechanism is true, and the belief is the standing reason the question cannot be settled, because a belief that makes every death reversible destroys the one institution that keeps the dead. Her body is the strongest evidence in the setting for that heresy, because it is half of what it would have been and still here. It is also the only body in the setting nobody can ask.
history: Vitrified from the fingertips inward as far as the fourth rib and then stopped, in the cohort that closed the line, with no marker and no ceremony and no practitioner anywhere on record.

Woke on the far side of a night on which every body of her clade had failed, and found that everything past the join had gone and everything behind it had not, and that she was therefore still able to feel the hand on the cold side.
Was claimed by a threshold guild on the measure that what is built is tested from the other side, which is the only arrangement anyone could think of for a body that is itself a boundary.
Began keeping the position of the join against the chalk line, which is the only record of the conversion's stage that has ever existed and which is kept on a guild wall by people who cannot read it.

Set a limit on the reading: the join is to be run with a line and not with a blade, once a season and never on request, because the only way to advance the sequence is to advance the sequence, and she has agreed to be the instrument for that exactly so many times.

personality.summary: A working specimen who has read her own interior so carefully that she has become the only authority on it, and who says so out loud before anybody relies on it.
traits: reports the position of the join before anyone asks for it
will not be examined more than the agreed number of times, and states the number first
treats a chalk line as an instrument and a blade as an argument
answers questions about the clade from memory she has already checked against her own body
mannerisms: holds the cold hand flat on the join whenever she is thinking
counts aloud under her breath while a line is being run
watches the line rather than the person holding it
keeps the coat fastened with the gloved hand, always
motivations: to have the conversion written down as a sequence before the sequence finishes running
to keep the reading at the agreed number and no higher
to be believed about her own body by somebody other than herself
flaws: cannot distinguish between what she remembers of her clade and what she has inferred from her own join
has begun to describe herself in the third person when she is being technical and has not noticed
is lonely in a way she has converted into thoroughness
personality.voice: Precise, unhurried and much warmer than her subject. She speaks about her own conversion the way a joiner talks about a joint, in tolerances, with the strong opinion that a thing held to a line can be trusted long after the hands that set it are gone.
taboos: she will not be cut into
she will not be asked to describe what a complete cast feels like
she will not be examined past the agreed number in any season

relationships.note: A lineage selected toward stillness until it stopped being tissue, with progressive silicate replacement from the extremities inward; her clade failed in one night when physical law was retuned and none has been born since, and she is the only body with a position in the sequence at all.

The working method for holding a vitrified body and the reason none has been born since; it was a ledger about maintenance, it was lost with the people who held it, and it would not have told anybody how the conversion happens even if it had survived.

That the glass kin were transferred rather than killed, because a law only stops holding what it inscribes; the mechanism is true and the belief makes every death reversible, so the one body that could settle it is the body nobody may ask.

They are the thing that killed the glass kin and the clearest evidence in the record that an element is a process and not an object, which is exactly what a conversion that stopped partway through is evidence of.

A guild that builds and then guards thresholds and takes as its measure that what it builds is tested from the other side; her boundary is the only structure in the setting that has never been tested from a side it could argue back from.

The only ground in the setting where a law is written twice and the second writing wins, and therefore the one place on record where a body caught between two versions of a physical law could be a specimen rather than a coincidence.

reference_stats.summary: Cannot fight, was never built to, and cannot be injured in the way a person fights. Everything she is capable of is passive and diagnostic. She is the only reading instrument in the setting that is also the thing being read, and every attempt to make her a combatant would break the single arrangement that keeps her intact.
strengths: impervious to qi of every kind, because glass does not conduct and there is nothing in her for a technique to travel through
cannot be warned, compelled or frightened, because each of those needs a meridian to reach and she has none
the cold side of her carries weight nothing softer can be expected to move, which is an accident of her condition and functions as a fact
weaknesses: shatters from the wrong side, and one contact with anything harder than she is is a total loss
the only reader of her own condition is herself, so no reading she gives has ever been independently checked
cannot be examined more than the agreed number of times in a season, and the number is not large
reference_stats.combat_read: Read the join. Everything forward of that diagonal is armoured against the entire qi vocabulary of the setting and the flesh behind it is not, so any engagement with her is a question of where she happens to be standing when it starts. Nobody should be in the same room with her who is holding something hard, because she is a shatterable object that weighs more than it looks and has no way to warn anybody. The safe answer is that she is never in the room.
reference_stats.notes: Her value is entirely in the join, and the join advances every time it is read. Treat any request to examine her as a request to finish converting her, and treat the agreed number of readings per season as the only thing standing between a useful record and a second empty set. She will state that number before she will state anything else.

art.palette_notes: Soap-grey wool and undyed linen above the join, and below it a cold mineral blue-green glass with the light travelling a long way into it before it returns, which must be visible and must never look like a lit lamp. Light her from a cold high source so the glass half catches a hard specular and the living half stays soft, and let the two halves disagree about the light, because that disagreement is the character. The join is the single most important line in the artwork: clean, diagonal, no seam and no gap. Do not add cracks, chips or damage anywhere. The internal clouding follows the vessels it replaced and should read as anatomy suspended in the material, not as dirt.

identity.realm: There is nothing to ascend and nothing to hold. A wake has no body to store in and copies itself out of other people's recollection rather than out of any parent, so it is denser the more consistently a room agrees about it and absent from a room that has stopped.

appearance.presentation: A figure entirely legible at the far end of a road and least so at arm's length, which two people walking towards it at once will describe differently on arrival.
appearance.age: Not determinable, and she has taken to giving a figure when asked, changing it, and then being asked the age of the figure.
appearance.build: Whatever the last four people agreed she was. The clothes fit, the hands are the right size for the hands, and nothing else has been checked.
appearance.complexion: Consistently unremarkable, in the way of a face nobody has had cause to notice closely.
appearance.hair: Worn back and tied, dark, with a parting that is the detail which changes between one description and the next.
appearance.eyes: Attentive and warm and, at close range, very slightly out of focus, because there is nobody behind them and the room behind them is doing the work.
appearance.palette: Road dust, undyed travelling wool, and a chalk-white at the collar that the charterhouse clerks put there and are the only people who agree on.
appearance.attire: A high-collared travelling coat, long-sleeved and laced at the wrist over gloves, with a house-issue cloak over it and the house mark at the throat. Fully covered, issued, and the only clothing in the setting with two owners' claims on it.
appearance.marks: Nothing at all, which is itself the finding: she carries no mark of any kind, and the charterhouse keeps three people who will testify that she has never been injured, which is the only evidence available that a body which cannot be marked cannot also be broken.
appearance.bearing: She stands in exactly the place in a group that the person behind her will remember her in, and she has stopped correcting people who put her elsewhere.

canon.role_in_story: A wake is fed by being agreed about and grows denser the more consistently a room agrees, which means the most durable thing this setting has ever seen one do is hold a thing that people agreed on. She is holding one. Two households on a road that closed struck terms about the use of a crossing and both of them are dead, and there is no copy of those terms anywhere, because the only instrument that ever held them was a thing two people agreed out loud in front of each other and then never wrote down. That agreement is what she is. She is the only surviving carrier of a live obligation, and every office that owes on it depends on a witness who cannot be examined, cannot be cross-questioned, cannot be shown a document, and has never once been asked what she thinks happened.
canon.first_appearance: First seen standing a half-step behind two clerks at a crossing desk, in exactly the place the man behind her will remember her in, and reaching for the third paper before either of them had finished explaining what it was for.
canon.lore:
The charterhouse sells one commodity and it is not a bed. It is a person the marshal's clerks will accept as a guarantor: passage is the only supply chain in the setting whose unit is a body, the law forbids levying a seat, and travel therefore has to be underwritten by somebody with no stake in the border. That office needs a guarantor who can be checked. It has one guarantee it can never check, and it bought her anyway, because the alternative is a crossing that carries nobody.

She is what this setting's memory arrangements make when a thing must survive and nobody can write it down. A wake has no body, no senses of its own, and exactly one thing, which is an observer it knows completely. It copies itself out of recollection rather than out of any parent, it borrows the qi of whoever is looking for as long as they go on looking, and it is fed by being wrong about, so it thickens where people agree and thins where they stop. The terms of the crossing are the perfect cargo for that, because they were never written, so there is no true version anywhere for her to be measured against, and what the setting holds instead is a settlement's consistent misremembering of what two dead people agreed.

The cost runs one way and it is not the cost anybody expects. Every reading of her terms makes her more solid and the terms vaguer. A wake densifies as a room's agreement hardens, so an office that takes her reading, settles the claim, writes the settlement down and circulates it is performing the one act that erases her, and because the settlement becomes the record, the record replaces the agreement, and the agreement was the thing holding her up. She has been read eleven times. She is much easier to see than she was and much less particular, and the charterhouse knows both facts and has not stopped reading her, because a vague terms settled is still a settled crossing and this setting offers no second carrier.
history: Came into being out of an agreement rather than a birth: two households on a closed road settling terms out loud in front of each other, then retold afterwards often enough by people who were not there to be assembled out of the retelling.
Was named Marchmain by a settlement that could not spell the name either signatory used, on the grounds that a house needs a word and the word does not have to be the true one.

Was sold to a charterhouse as a guarantor nobody could check, with the buyers in full knowledge that a claim resting on her cannot be cross-examined, because the alternative was that the crossing closed.
Was read for the first time and noticed afterwards to be easier to see than before, which is the ordinary condition of a wake and is the whole of the problem.

Set the number of readings she will accept, in writing, on the charterhouse wall beside the ledger, after the eleventh reading left her terms general enough to be agreed by anybody and specific enough to be worth nothing.

personality.summary: The most valuable unread document on the plains, who has decided that the only power she has is to be difficult to use.
traits: signs nothing and attends every reading
states her number before she states her terms
answers questions about the agreement with the agreement and never with her own recollection
puts herself where the room will remember her, deliberately
mannerisms: keeps a half-step behind whoever is currently speaking to the room
watches the clerk's pen rather than the clerk's face
repeats the last clause of anything read to her exactly as it was read
steps out of the line of sight when two people disagree about her in her hearing
motivations: to be read a fixed number of times and then left alone
to keep one clause specific enough to matter
to be cross-examined once, by anybody, at any cost to herself
flaws: cannot tell whether the terms she carries are the terms that were agreed or the terms that are agreed about
has begun to enjoy being irreplaceable and knows that is how a useful thing stops being useful
is not a person and has never once been able to use that as a defence, only as a fact
personality.voice: Level, unhurried and enormously patient, and identical in every retelling. She speaks in the words of the settlement's version and not her own, and the one thing she has never done is describe what she saw.
taboos: she will not read past the number on the wall
she will not speak first about the agreement
she will not stand in front of anybody else

relationships.note: It is what a life-form allowance produces when a life's law has no slot to write the form down in, so it has no anatomy and no senses and copies itself out of recollection rather than out of any parent; it is fed by being agreed about, which makes an unrecorded agreement the one cargo it can hold intact.

The roadside house sells the one commodity the crossings charge for, which is a person the marshal's clerks will accept as a guarantor; it bought her knowing that a claim resting on her can never be cross-examined, because the alternative was a closed crossing.

It collects debts of access rather than money at the one pass over the ridge and has to decide who is owed the gate, so all of its business turns on a claim whose only evidence is a thing that cannot be examined and grows harder to read every time it is read.

A split tally settles a dispute because both halves are needed and therefore both parties consent; her terms are the same arrangement without the stick, and the standing disagreement between a notary's evidence and a credential's cloth has a third case sitting between the two.

The only exact record below the spirit peaks carries sixty years as a summary instead of entry by entry, in a culture whose whole practice is that a count is never an estimate, and a gap in one is exactly what a body no instrument can read produces.

A line whose succession is agreed in a room and never written is the only household form that will hold an echoless, and it is also the only form a wake can hold at all; her terms survive precisely because they were agreed aloud, and an echoless is what attention produces when there is nothing behind it, so the one ear in the setting able to leave a place's sound uncontaminated by a listener cannot be the one that remembers the agreement.

reference_stats.summary: Cannot be fought, cannot be injured and cannot be found, and the only capability the setting has ever wanted from her is the ability to be believed about something she cannot remember. Every account of a fight that involves her is really a description of the room.
strengths: thickens wherever two people agree, so the only thing that can make her thin is an argument about her inside her hearing
cannot be compelled, technique-struck, warned or frightened, because all four need something in her to reach and she has nothing
holds a claim alive that has no written copy anywhere, which nothing else in the setting can do
weaknesses: no reading of her can be cross-examined, so any claim resting on her is unenforceable by anyone who understands what that means
her presence is maintained by the room looking at her, so she is weakest in precisely the settings where she is most needed
gets less particular every time she is made more solid, so repeated use degrades the only thing she exists for
reference_stats.combat_read: Do not look for a fight; there is no body and nothing to strike. The correct behaviour in her presence is to stop talking about her and leave, because a wake thins when a room stops discussing it and a room that has stopped discussing it has just stopped reading her. Anyone who wants her gone should decline to find her interesting, which costs nothing and is the only technique in the setting that works on her.
reference_stats.notes: She is a document with a pulse, and the pulse is made of attention. Every hour spent reading her is an hour of her life and an hour of her precision, which is why the charterhouse has the number on the wall and is ignoring it. If she is ever asked to cross-examine herself she will agree, and that agreement will be the first true thing anybody has had out of her.

art.palette_notes: Road dust, undyed travelling wool and one chalk-white at the collar, which is the only crisp edge permitted anywhere on her and must never be repeated on her person. Light her warmly and let her resolve late, with slightly reduced contrast at the outline against any background: the ambiguity is a viewing effect, not an effect in the illustration, so never a glow and never a dissolve. Her eyes are the thing to get right at close range, since they are warm and attentive and very slightly out of focus, and the unfocused quality must read as room behind them rather than as a rendering fault. Never give her a hard edge, a rim light or a shadow that describes her shape exactly. The house mark at the throat is worth one close shot on its own.
